item.title: Government Climate Policy Reform Threatens Economic Growth
item.description: Business groups warn that proposed government climate policy reform will destroy jobs and hamper economic growth across key sectors.

item.title: Federal Spending Cuts Urged to Reduce Ballooning Budget Deficit
item.description: Conservative fiscal watchdogs and lawmakers urge sweeping federal spending cuts to address the growing national deficit and reduce government waste in discretionary programmes.

item.title: Border Security Bill Advances as Migration Crisis Intensifies
item.description: Legislation strengthening border enforcement advanced in the Senate as alarm over the migration crisis grows and lawmakers warned of threats to border communities.
